lede: Infrastructure climate adaptation helps planners and engineers assess how climate hazards can disrupt assets and services. For infrastructure planners, engineers, project managers, and asset management professionals, the course offers a practical approach to identifying risks and prioritizing resilience actions. Participants learn to interpret climate information, assess asset vulnerability, compare adaptation options using cost and risk considerations, and build investment cases for design, procurement, operations, and maintenance decisions.
audienceIntro: This course is crafted for professionals who are at the forefront of infrastructure planning and management, facing the challenges of a changing climate.

modules: Climate Risk and Infrastructure Performance Basics
Climate Risk Screening for Projects and Assets

Operations, Maintenance, and Climate-Resilient Asset Management
Governance, Compliance, and Safeguards for Climate Adaptation
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of infrastructure planning and management. Familiarity with climate data and risk assessment methodologies is beneficial but not required.
